src.quote: I will start coordinating with the Partner agency so that when you arrive, you can go directly to the site, use the intended staging area, and start preparing for the transfer period.
And Sofia, before Raj and I leave, can you get us a direct point of contact we can call if we have trouble getting into the site or reaching the right staging area?
Yes. Absolutely.
We also need to know whether there is a specific connection route or entry process because of the file size and equipment we are bringing.
I need to check that it is suitable for your transfer requirements.
Right. I will work through that so you know which route to use.

ops.label: Set up observer information and day-by-day schedule process

src.quote: A separate process is being developed so that group can stay informed about the day-by-day flow of activity.
Our side is developing a flexible day-by-day schedule so observers can decide when to attend.

ops.label: Send yesterday's discussion information, partner-session summaries and materials, and today's transcript to the group

src.quote: I will send everyone information from yesterday’s discussion this morning.
I will provide today’s transcript to this group, and you will also get the summaries from yesterday’s partner session.
I am putting those materials together now to get them out today.

ops.text: Agreed approach: the 18th is the setup and configuration day, not necessarily the day every participant arrives. Files are staged at the intended final location on arrival, and another workspace is used while the technical team finishes setup.

src.quote: I think the eighteenth is being treated as the setup and configuration day, not necessarily the day every participant has to arrive.
Yes. That is probably the best approach.

ops.text: Ortiz prefers to deliver files to the staging location, set up the equipment and be out of the way before the active transfer period, provided the staging location is identified ahead of time.

src.quote: If the staging location can be identified ahead of time, I would prefer to deliver the files there, set up the equipment, and be out of the way before the active transfer period begins.

ops.text: Load concern at the staging area: it may have temporary flooring or lightweight panels, and the equipment and file cases are heavy. Brooks thinks the intended area may be stable but it must be verified. Another nearby staging area is the fallback, within this same task. No owner has accepted the verification or the request that the partner agency be told the load.

src.quote: The picture of the staging area looks like it may have temporary flooring or lightweight panels.
I think the intended area may be stable, but we need to verify it.

ops.text: A partner-site slide deck with location details is planned, per Alvarez.

src.quote: There will be a partner-site slide deck with location details.

ops.text: Ortiz needs the direct point of contact before he and Patel leave, for trouble getting into the site or reaching the right staging area. Planned departure is the fourteenth; the month is not confirmed (see conflict flag on AI-207).

src.quote: Raj and I are planning to leave on the fourteenth.

ops.text: A connection route is identified but has not yet been checked for suitability against the transfer requirements. Ortiz's concern is arriving with the files and equipment, using the wrong route, and finding that the site cannot support the transfer.

src.quote: There is a route identified. I need to check that it is suitable for your transfer requirements.
The last thing we want is to arrive with the files and equipment, use the wrong route, and find out that the site cannot support what we are trying to do.

ops.text: Workstation needs are power, workspace and probably internet backhaul; the transfer equipment connects directly to the support system. The site has no dedicated power. Ortiz and Patel are bringing a portable power unit and expect it to support the equipment.

src.quote: We need power, workspace, and probably internet backhaul.
The transfer equipment will connect directly to the support system.
There is no dedicated power. We are bringing the portable power unit.
We should be able to support the equipment with that.

ops.text: Connectivity status: Ortiz expects it to be fine, with the normal connection capability and a backup option.

src.quote: Connectivity should be fine. We will have our normal connection capability and a backup option.

ops.text: Monitoring equipment mounting is unverified. The stand may need lowering in high wind or vibration, and the standard clips may not be sufficient. Asking for the equipment documentation has been suggested but no one has been assigned to request it. Fallback: lower the working height or keep the equipment at ground level, to be settled once the transfer plan is known.

src.quote: The concern is stability.
The standard clips may not be sufficient.
We can ask for the equipment documentation.

ops.text: Placement of the monitoring equipment (on the stand or on ground-level tables) is undecided and depends on the final transfer plan. The last transfer kept it on separate tables, and the workstation carried only communications gear.

src.quote: We kept the monitoring equipment on separate tables.
We may place monitoring equipment on the stand for better visibility, but that depends on the final transfer plan.

ops.text: Ortiz and Patel plan to leave on the fourteenth and expect to arrive on the seventeenth, though travel could take several days. Arriving on the seventeenth lets them settle before the eighteenth. Ortiz says travel has enough unknowns already.

src.quote: We expect to arrive on the seventeenth.
Okay. That gives us some flexibility. If we arrive on the seventeenth, we can get settled and be ready for the eighteenth.
Travel has enough unknowns already.

ops.text: Transfer dates are being cleaned up: the period discussed as May 18 to 28 is now described as May 18 to 22. Working staff are expected Monday through Friday, with travel on Sunday and Saturday. What this means for participants not working hands-on is still open.

src.quote: The transfer period that had been discussed as May eighteenth through May twenty-eighth is now being described as May eighteenth through May twenty-second.

ops.text: Ortiz has sent the observer names he has to the event coordinator; the list may still grow or shrink. A point of contact is working with the event coordinator to capture observer attendees.

src.quote: I sent the names I have to the event coordinator, but that list may still grow or shrink.
We have a specific point of contact working with the event coordinator to capture observer attendees.

newVsExisting.whyNew: Keeping observers informed and building a day-by-day observer schedule is not partner-site access, staging or point-of-contact work, which AI-204 and AI-205 cover.

Sending the discussion information, partner-session summaries and materials, and today's transcript is a distribution step with its own completion condition, not the site access or staging work in AI-204; it carries partner-session content, so it is project work rather than meeting administration under rule 4.
